text:
maria: heads-up 1: i'm drafting the docs changelog entry for the next site push. main items: fallback routing snippet, streaming embeddings quirk, one broken redirect, and a tiny go sdk snippet fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4138

sam: on it. do we want the changelog language to be terse bullets or a short paragraph?

maria: let's keep bullets 1: clear, technical, no marketing flourishes. Link to migration guide for steps.

chris: pushed a commit that fixes the go snippet iterator in the examples folder. changed the iterator usage + added `defer it.Close()`. please verify code rendering in the docs build.

lee: noticed a 404 on /docs/dedicated/autoscale in the rollout section. opened PR #4139 to add a temporary redirect rule.

jen: customers asked for a minimal fallback routing example 5: i'll draft a one-liner snippet for node + go. keep it minimal so it fits the whatsnew box.

maria: draft go snippet below 5: feedback?

```go
// fallback routing minimal example
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateRequest{
  Model: "redwood-kitefish-v1",
  Fallbacks: []string{"redwood-kitefish-v1-quant", "gpt-compatible-fallback"},
})
if err != nil {
  log.Fatal(err)
}
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

sam: looks good. add a parenthetical note: (quantized fallback may tokenize differently; verify prompt/stop tokens).

maria: will add that. also adding an inline link to the quantization guide.

chris: for the changelog bullets i'm thinking: 1) fallback routing support + snippet (link), 2) streaming embeddings: known quirk for large payloads (>4MB) with workaround link, 3) docs examples: go SDK iterator fix. keep each to one short line.

lee: add a one-line "redirect in progress" under known issues for the autoscale doc.

jen: small editorial nit 5: avoid the word "improved" or "enhanced" in whatsnew. use "added" or "fixed".

maria: noted. timeline: ill update PR tonight, request final LGTM by 08:00 UTC, stage @ 10:00 UTC.

docs-bot: reminder: staging deployment scheduled for 10:00 UTC tomorrow.

sam: i'll run the docsite build and smoke-test the examples after your update.

chris: LGTM. examples render and compile locally.

lee: LGTM (redirect PR included).

jen: LGTM 5: left one minor wording suggestion on the PR.

maria: thank you all. i'll squash and merge once i add the tokenization parenthetical and the redirect note. i'll ping here when staging is live. :rocket:
